第006章 爆你菊（求推荐
看到岳雨房间的墙壁倒塌，楚莹看着岳雨有些诧异，“怎么回事？”
“咳，刚才一道雷电劈了进来，就这样了。”岳雨撒谎脸色丝毫不变，他不想让楚莹知道那雷电是自己发出的。自己无灵根，无灵属性，无法修炼，却能发出一道雷电，让楚莹知道了也不知道怎么解释。
也是岳雨一时心急，想试试雷芒指的威力，所以才一时疏忽。
楚莹依旧感觉不到岳雨体内有丝毫灵力，觉得雷电应该不是他发出的。正在这时，店里的一名中年管事来到了房前，这么大的动静，他自然要来看看。
看着前面的墙壁被震塌，管事虽然心中有些不快，但也不敢表露出来，看着楚莹一脸恭敬的问道：“姑娘，这是？”
“没什么事，损失我双倍偿还。”楚莹不以为然。
“不用不用，小小的一个墙壁而已。”管事急忙说道。在他心中，楚莹的身份绝对不一般，所以他并不会让其偿还损失。
“嗯。”楚莹轻应一声便回了房间。
岳雨看着管事，道：“能不能给我换个房间？”
看着眼前这个普通的少年，管事有些不屑，冷哼一声，道：“勉强着住吧。”随即转身离去。
“我靠，欺软怕硬的家伙。”岳雨暗骂一声，看着管事那肥大的屁股，嘴角勾起，露出一抹邪笑。雷芒指施展而出，手指一点，雷芒飞出，直直向那管事的屁眼袭去。
“爆你菊！嘿嘿。”岳雨猥琐的笑着，随即转身走向楚莹的房间。
管事并未发觉身后的雷芒，他的修为也只是通灵境一阶，感应能力并不强。随即，只觉得屁眼猛地一痛，痛得有些发麻，心里微微一惊，同时心中怒气翻腾，“谁袭击老子？”看着周围，一个人影也没有，有些不解，随即便阴沉着脸离开。
岳雨不知道的是，刚才楚莹已经释放出了灵识，观察着自己，他的一击雷芒，楚莹也清楚的看到了。
“怎么可能？他身上没有灵根，没有丝毫灵力，怎么会发出雷电之力？”楚莹有些惊讶，即使自己见多识广，也搞不清楚这是为何。
“难道他修炼了特殊的隐匿功法？”楚莹猜想着。见岳雨走进来，便恢复了淡然的神色。
“楚姑娘，我出去走走，你看……”岳雨欲言又止，楚莹有些不明白他的意思，便问道：“怎么？”
岳雨尴尬一笑，“就是，出去转悠自然会看到好东西，看到好东西我便自然想要买，买的话又需要……”说到这里岳雨看着楚莹，心里感觉有些不好意思，一个大男人像一个女人要钱，岳雨脸皮再厚也不好意思直说。
“这样啊。“看着岳雨尴尬的神色，楚莹忍俊不禁，微微一笑，随手拿出一个精致的钱袋便给了岳雨。

第一次看到楚莹露出笑容，可谓是嫣然一笑，百媚生，岳雨呆了片刻便接过钱袋急忙离开。见岳雨着急的离开，楚莹虽然疑惑便没有多想，盘膝入定，周围缕缕灵气不断融入体内，身体之上散发着点点蓝芒，犹如圣洁的仙女一般。
走出房间，岳雨松了口气，看了看自己的**顶起的小帐篷，叹道：“不是哥的定力差，简直太美了。”
随后，岳雨便走出了店外，他出去也并不是为了买东西，而是为了升级！做善事便能升级，这也太简单了，而且再获得一百经验就能升级了，岳雨不免有些期待下一个技能会是什么。
岳雨走在大街之上，见人们不时盯着自己的衣着，于是便进了一家服装店内。挑了几件白色的长袍与白靴，便穿在了身上。
站在用水晶制作的镜子前，看着镜中的自己，岳雨不免觉得自己有了几分书生的气质。一袭似雪的白衣，更是让他显得更加帅气。
付了两枚金币后，岳雨便走出了服装店。
“这里也未免太过太平了吧，这我怎么做善事啊。”岳雨走了三条大街，依旧没找到做善事的机会，路上连一个乞丐也没有。
正在这时，岳雨看到一个古董摊上，一名中年妇女正愁眉苦脸的坐在那，像是在为什么事发愁一般，岳雨心中一动，便走了过去。
“大娘，看你愁眉苦脸的样子，是有什么事吗？有没有需要我帮忙的地方？”岳雨一脸善意的问道。
中年妇女抬起头，见岳雨的衣着华丽，觉得面前的少年可能会是一个有钱的人，还有帮助自己的意思，心中一喜，看着岳雨，就像是看到了希望一般。“公子，你愿意帮我？”中年妇女问道。
“当然，我这人一向爱做善事，你有什么事就说吧。”终于找到了做善事的机会，岳雨心中也是一喜。
“公子，我家相公身患重病，需要及时救治，可是，家里的钱却不够，我便只能把家里的古董拿出来卖，公子你愿意帮助我？”中年妇女看到了希望，有些激动。
同时，系统声音响起，叮！是否帮助对方？
系统声突然响起，让岳雨有些意外，不过有任务，自然要接。
“是！”岳雨应道。
叮！任务已接受。限时三天内完成。
接了任务，岳雨说道：“当然，你说吧，需要多少钱？”
“需要一百金币。”中年妇女如实说道。
“这是两百金币，你都拿去吧。”岳雨将手中的钱袋递了过去。
“谢谢，谢谢。”中年妇女很是感激，高兴的眼泪都流了出来。

叮！任务完成，获得经验一百。
叮！经验达到六百，是否升级？
“是！”
竟然获得了一百经验，岳雨很是兴奋。
叮！等级提升，目前等级六级。获得五点属性，一个技能。
抑制住心中的兴奋，岳雨淡淡一笑，道：“没事，应该做的。”
“公子，这些古董全部送给你，还请你收下。”中年妇女只能将古董送给岳雨以表感谢。
对方一片好意，收了也能使中年妇女心里得到一些宽慰，岳雨便答应了。
岳雨提着一大包古董，哼着小曲走在大街之上，“牛啊，不用面对逆境从中突破，做做善事就能升级，哈哈，强大。”心中想着，一阵感叹。
回到店内，岳雨将古董放到地上后，便坐在了床上，人物栏在脑海中浮现。
人物：岳雨
职业：灵修
等级：六级。（力武境六阶）
属性点：5
技能：6
看着新技能的属性，岳雨轻叹了一声，“逆天啊。”
技能：倍击，攻击性技能。等级：一等灵技。（可升级）施展后力量提升一倍，随着等级的提升，可翻倍叠加。目前实力，持续时间三十秒。熟练度：0/1000
翻倍叠加，现在使用便可使力量增加一倍，技能升级后在原先的基础上再叠加，也就是四倍，继续叠加之后就是八倍，再次叠加，十六倍！再叠加三十二倍！六十四倍！一百二十八倍！……
比如，你和一个实力相当的对手打得难分难解，然后使用倍击，力量瞬间提升一倍，或者四倍，八倍，一百二十倍，想不赢都难啊。所以，这个技能简直就是逆天！杀手锏！
——————————————

Chapter 006: Exploding your anus (please recommend
Seeing the wall of Yue Yu's room collapse, Chu Ying looked at Yue Yu with some surprise, "What's going on?"
"Ahem, a thunder and lightning struck just now, that's all." Yue Yu lied, his face unchanged at all. He didn't want Chu Ying to know that the thunder and lightning was caused by himself. She has no spiritual roots, no spiritual attributes, and cannot practice, but she can send out a thunder and lightning. Even if Chu Ying knows it, she doesn't know how to explain it.
It was also because Yue Yu was anxious and wanted to test the power of the thunder finger, so he was negligent.
Chu Ying still couldn't feel the slightest spiritual power in Yue Yu's body, and felt that the thunder and lightning was not caused by him. At this moment, a middle-aged steward from the store came to the house. With such a big movement, he naturally wanted to take a look.
Seeing the wall in front of him being shattered, the steward felt a little unhappy, but he didn't dare to show it. He looked at Chu Ying and asked respectfully: "Girl, is this?"
"It's nothing. I'll repay double the loss." Chu Ying disagreed.
"No, no, it's just a small wall." The steward said hurriedly. In his mind, Chu Ying's status was absolutely extraordinary, so he would not let her repay the loss.
"Yes." Chu Ying responded softly and returned to the room.
Yue Yu looked at the steward and said, "Can you change my room?"
Looking at the ordinary young man in front of him, the steward felt a little disdainful. He snorted coldly and said, "Just live with it." Then he turned and left.
"Damn, you're a bully." Yue Yu cursed secretly, looking at the steward's fat ass, raising the corners of his mouth and revealing an evil smile. The lightning finger was used, and with a single finger, the lightning flew out and hit the manager's butthole.
"Blow your ass! Hehe." Yue Yu smiled obscenely, then turned around and walked towards Chu Ying's room.
The steward did not notice the thunder behind him. His cultivation was only at the first level of the psychic realm, and his sensing ability was not strong. Immediately, I felt a sudden pain in my butthole, which was numbing. I was slightly startled, and at the same time my heart was filled with anger. "Who attacked me?" Looking around, there was no one around. He was a little confused, and then left with a gloomy face.
What Yue Yu didn't know was that Chu Ying had released her spiritual consciousness just now and was observing him. Chu Ying could also clearly see his lightning strike.
"How is it possible? He has no spiritual roots and no spiritual power. How can he emit the power of thunder and lightning?" Chu Ying was a little surprised. Even though she was well-informed, she couldn't figure out why.
"Did he practice special concealment skills?" Chu Ying guessed. Seeing Yue Yu walk in, he regained his calm expression.
"Miss Chu, I'm going out for a walk. Look..." Yue Yu hesitated, but Chu Ying didn't understand what he meant, so she asked, "What?"
Yue Yu smiled awkwardly, "That's right, when you go out and wander around, you will naturally see good things. When I see good things, I will naturally want to buy them. If I want to buy them, I need..." At this point, Yue Yu looked at Chu Ying and felt a little embarrassed. A grown man asked for money like a woman. No matter how thick-skinned Yue Yu was, he was embarrassed to speak directly.
"That's it." Seeing Yue Yu's embarrassed look, Chu Ying couldn't help laughing, smiled slightly, took out an exquisite money bag and gave it to Yue Yu.
Seeing Chu Ying smile for the first time, it could be said to be a charming smile, Bai Meisheng, Yue Yu stayed for a moment, then took the money bag and left hurriedly. Seeing Yue Yu leaving in a hurry, Chu Ying was confused but didn't think much about it. She crossed her legs and fell into meditation. Wisps of spiritual energy around her continued to merge into her body. Her body was emitting blue light, like a holy fairy.
After walking out of the room, Yue Yu breathed a sigh of relief, looked at the small tent held up by his own breasts, and sighed: "It's not because of my poor concentration, it's so beautiful."
Afterwards, Yue Yu walked out of the store. He didn't go out to buy anything, but to upgrade! It's too simple to level up by doing good deeds, and you can level up by gaining another hundred experience points. Yue Yu can't help but look forward to it.What will be the next skill?
Yue Yu walked on the street and saw people staring at his clothes from time to time, so he entered a clothing store. I picked some white robes and white boots and put them on.
Standing in front of a mirror made of crystal and looking at himself in the mirror, Yue Yu couldn't help but feel that he had a somewhat scholarly temperament. Dressed in white clothes that looked like snow, he looked even more handsome.
After paying two gold coins, Yue Yu walked out of the clothing store.
"It's too peaceful here. How can I do good deeds?" Yue Yu walked three streets and still found no opportunity to do good deeds. There was not even a beggar on the road.
At this moment, Yue Yu saw a middle-aged woman sitting there at an antique stall with a sad face, as if she was worried about something. Yue Yu felt a move in her heart and walked over.
"Auntie, look at your sad face. Is there something wrong? Is there anything you need my help with?" Yue Yu asked with a kind face.
The middle-aged woman raised her head and saw Yue Yu's gorgeous clothes. She felt that the young man in front of her might be a rich man and wanted to help her. She felt happy and looked at Yue Yu as if she saw hope. "Sir, are you willing to help me?" the middle-aged woman asked.
"Of course, I always like to do good deeds. If you have anything to say, just tell me." Finally finding an opportunity to do good deeds, Yue Yu felt happy.
"Master, my husband-in-law is seriously ill and needs timely treatment. However, the money at home is not enough, so I can only sell the antiques at home. Master, are you willing to help me?" The middle-aged woman saw hope and was a little excited.
At the same time, the system sound sounded, Ding! Do you help the other party?
The system beep suddenly sounded, which surprised Yue Yu, but he had a task, so he had to take it.
"Yes!" Yue Yu responded.
bite! Mission accepted. Time limit is three days to complete.
After accepting the task, Yue Yu said: "Of course, tell me, how much does it cost?"
"It takes one hundred gold coins." The middle-aged woman said truthfully.
"Here are two hundred gold coins. Take them all." Yue Yu handed over the money bag in his hand.
"Thank you, thank you." The middle-aged woman was so grateful that she shed tears of joy.
bite! The mission is completed and one hundred experience points are gained.
bite! My experience reaches 600. Do you want to upgrade?
"Yes!"
Yue Yu was very excited after actually gaining 100 experience points.
bite! The level has been improved, currently level six. Gain five attributes and one skill.
Suppressing the excitement in his heart, Yue Yu smiled lightly and said: "It's okay, I should do it."
"Sir, all these antiques are given to you, please accept them." The middle-aged woman could only give the antiques to Yue Yu to express her gratitude.
The other party had good intentions, and accepting it would bring some relief to the middle-aged woman, so Yue Yu agreed.
Yue Yu carried a large bag of antiques and walked on the street humming a tune. "Awesome, you don't have to face adversity to break through. You can level up by doing good deeds. Haha, you are powerful." Thinking in his heart, he sighed.
After returning to the store, Yue Yu put the antiques on the ground and sat on the bed, with the character column emerging in his mind.
Character: Yue Yu
Occupation: Spirituality
Level: Level 6. (Level 6 of Liwu Realm)
Attribute points: 5
Skills: 6
Looking at the attributes of the new skill, Yue Yu sighed softly, "It's incredible."
Skills: Double hit, offensive skills. Level: First-class spiritual skill. (Upgradeable) After being used, the power will be doubled. As the level increases, it can be doubled and stacked. The current strength lasts thirty seconds. Proficiency: 0/1000
Double stacking, use it now to double your power. After the skill is upgraded, it will be stacked on the original basis, which is four times. After continuing to stack, it will be eight times. If it is stacked again, it will be sixteen times! Add another thirty-two times! Sixty-four times! One hundred and twenty-eight times! …
For example, you are in an inseparable fight with an opponent of equal strength., and then use Double Strike to instantly increase your strength by one time, four times, eight times, or one hundred and twenty times. It’s hard not to win. Therefore, this skill is simply incredible! The killer weapon!
